hero.p1: Securing things has been my obsession since my teenage years. Early on, out of necessity, I learned to understand systems from the inside rather than just live with them. That logic never left me : from the Defence forces to certifications, up to today, where I'm building the skills and tools to secure entire infrastructures. Cloud, networks, AI.
hero.p2: Smidjan is that path made visible. Not an agency selling inflated numbers : a practitioner who shows his work, what he can do and what he can't do yet.
hero.availability: Based in Wallonia, authorised to work in the EU. Open to freelance missions and opportunities, in Brussels, Wallonia or remote.

cyfun.title: A CyFun audit tool I'm building
cyfun.lead: An audit methodology aligned with the CyFun framework, designed to prepare SMEs for NIS2. Here is what it guarantees.
cyfun.b2: Read only : never modifies your systems.
cyfun.b3: Explicit scope, no autonomous network discovery.
cyfun.b6: Remediation validated by a human, never auto-executed.
cyfun.b7: No data retained after the audit.
cyfun.b8: Clear chain : report, prioritised remediation, hardening.
cyfun.honesty: Assisted self-assessment and preparation. This is not an official certification, which is reserved for BELAC-accredited bodies.

approche.title: Where it comes from
approche.p1: As a teenager, in a constrained environment, I learned to understand how systems work rather than just live with them. Not out of abstract curiosity : out of necessity. That's where I developed a taste for opening the hood, for seeing how things hold together, or give way.
approche.p2: What I can do, I show with verifiable proof. What I can't do yet, I don't claim.
